args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 is a high severity vulnerability in fastjson:
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.
Affected: >=2.0.0 <2.9.4. pgrade from from 2.8.0 to the fixed 2.9.4.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in requirements.txt to address **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity).

## Details
CVE-2026-31337 is an unbounded recursion vulnerability in fastjson triggered when parsing deeply nested arrays. The affected range is `<2.9.4` (and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`); we were pinned to 2.8.0. This upgrades to the fixed patch release 2.9.4.

CI on this branch (run `ci-0001`, commit c8b8ab7878) passed.
